title: Income Annuities Contract Issue and Purchase Terms
content:
## 1. Issue conditions

An Ashgrove Income Annuities tier is issued only when the annuitant's age on the issue date is between the tier's lowest and highest issue ages, and, on a joint tier, the younger annuitant is at least the tier's lowest joint age. The purchase amount must be at least the tier's smallest non-qualified purchase, or its smallest IRA purchase for an IRA contract, and must come from one of the tier's accepted purchase sources.

## 2. Applying the purchase amount

The purchase amount is applied only while the contract status is applied. This is read from the contract record of the same contract to which the purchase amount is being applied — its status as the system shows it, not as anyone describes it.

| Contract status on the record | Purchase amount may be applied? |
|---|---|
| Applied | Yes |
| Any other status (income active, payments suspended, declined and the rest) | No |

## 3. Period certain on an IRA

On an IRA contract the period certain may not exceed the tier's longest period certain allowed on an IRA contract.

## 4. First payment, payment day and frequency

The first payment date must be at least the tier's earliest first-payment days and no more than its latest first-payment months after the issue date, on a payment day from 1 to the tier's latest payment day. The frequency is one of the tier's installment frequencies, and an installment below the tier's smallest gross installment requires a less frequent mode.

## 5. Cost-of-living rate

A cost-of-living increase rate may be chosen from the tier's cost-of-living options at purchase only.

## 6. Rate lock

The payout rate quoted at application is held for the tier's rate lock period while exchange or transfer funds are in transit; funds arriving later are priced at the rate in effect on arrival.

## 7. Irrevocability

The contract is irrevocable: it has no cash surrender value; the frequency cannot be changed where the tier does not allow a frequency change after issue; and payments cannot be assigned, sold or pledged where the tier does not allow assignment.

## 8. Declined or withdrawn applications

An application declined or withdrawn before issue has its money returned without interest.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A first payment date falling on the 29th of a month is outside a payment day range that ends at the 28th.
- Exchange funds that arrive within the rate lock period are priced at the rate quoted at application; funds arriving after it are priced at the rate in effect on arrival.
- A purchase payment received for a contract whose record already shows income active is not applied to it, the status no longer being applied.
